::: {.lead-intro}
I'm Eriola, a Government Operational Researcher and geospatial analyst. For more than 15 years I've applied quantitative, geospatial and statistical methods to complex problems across government, academia and the private sector. Here I write about turning messy data into clear, reproducible analysis, communicating uncertainty honestly, and how AI is changing the way we work with spatial data.
:::

### Pedestrian casualties on London's roads
<p class="meta">Spatial analysis · Python · Interactive dashboard</p>

22,108 pedestrian casualties in Greater London, 2021–2025: where they concentrate along the street network, what about the built environment goes with them, and how far serious casualties are from trauma care.

### Article 4 and constraints checker, Kingston
<p class="meta">Planning tool · JavaScript · Planning Data API</p>

Checks one property, or a whole CSV of them, against Article 4 directions, conservation areas, listed buildings, flood zones and more, flagging borderline cases near a boundary. Built as a Local Land Charges aid for the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames.
